newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say Feb growth stronger.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say Feb growth stronger.

text.p: The Cincinnati chapter of the National Association of Purchasing Management said Friday its February report indicated a stronger recovery than was seen in January. It was also slightly stronger than any month in 1996, the group said.
"The moderation seen in January was not sustained in February and we would expect a strengthening in the recovery as we enter spring," the group said.
Commodity prices rose at a lower level than in January. Service and equipment prices rose at the same level. Steel, sand castings, pallets and some chemical prices rose.
